metadata.description: The scouting platform for African football. Human-scouted reports on players from the Premier League to the academies — built by scouts on the ground.

hero.subhead: Comprehensive football analytics and scouting platform for teams, agencies, and media. Get the edge with real-time data and advanced insights.

pricing.title: Subscription
pricing.subtitle: Choose the perfect plan for your scouting needs.

features.title: Extensive.
features.subtitle: Everything you need to analyze, scout, and discover football talent globally.

playerStats.title: Detailed player stats
playerStats.desc: Granular data on passing, shooting, defensive actions and more.

tactical.title: Advanced tactical analysis
tactical.desc: Heatmaps, passing networks, and formation breakdowns.

matchReports.title: Comprehensive match reports
matchReports.desc: Automated insights instantly generated after every game.

injuries.title: Real-time injury updates
injuries.desc: Track availability and physical condition across leagues.

transfer.title: Transfer market insights
transfer.desc: Track value fluctuations and transfer probabilities in real-time.

contracts.title: Contract details
contracts.desc: Comprehensive database of player contracts and agency representation.

visualizations.title: Interactive visualizations
visualizations.desc: Create custom charts and graphs to present to your board.

platform.minCharacters: Type at least 2 characters to search every league.

language.label: Choose language
language.tip: Pick from the list — more added over time.
language.footerTip: Tip: your browser can also translate any page on demand.

signIn.title: Sign in to your scouting desk
signIn.subtitle: Continue with your account credentials or use a Google account linked to ScoutingReport Africa.

signUp.title: Join the scouting desk
signUp.subtitle: Set up your account with email and password, or continue with Google. Scouts and analysts get elevated permissions on invite.
